# Local browser assets

These files retain the versions already used by the theme; no library upgrade was
part of the layout refresh. Original license banners remain in the distributions.

| Asset | Upstream source | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| jQuery 3.2.1 | https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.2.1.min.js | MIT; see jquery/LICENSE.txt |
| Bootstrap 3.1.1 CSS, JavaScript and fonts | https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/tree/v3.1.1/dist | MIT; see bootstrap/LICENSE |
| Font Awesome 4.7.0 CSS and fonts | https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/tree/v4.7.0 | CSS MIT, fonts SIL OFL 1.1; see font-awesome/README.md and https://fontawesome.com/v4/license/ |

The Font Awesome README is the original upstream attribution and license mapping
(CC BY 3.0). Font Awesome by Dave Gandy. Institutional branding is stored separately.
MathJax remains a single pinned external 2.7.1 loader on proposal pages; its runtime
loads additional components, so mathematics still needs an Internet connection.
Syntax highlighting uses Jekyll's existing Rouge renderer, with local styles.
